title: McpSearchFilingsInput
description: Input of search_filings: keyword search over the lexical, facts and tables lanes with rank fusion.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (design contract §6.1). An ISO-8601 instant with an explicit offset, or a date meaning 00:00 America/New_York on that date. Naive datetimes are rejected. Must not precede 1994-01-01 or follow the request time; the server enforces the upper bound. Omitted means the request time. The instant used is echoed as evidence_context.effective_as_of.

timestamp_mode.description: strict (the default and the only hosted mode) shows a document only when its verified acceptance time is at or before the cutoff. approximate is self-hosted only and carries no temporal guarantee (design contract §6.2).

items.description: Company identifier: entity_id, ten-digit CIK, ticker or name.

corpus_version_id.description: Corpus version to read. Omitted resolves to the active version; an unknown, unpublished or retired pin returns pin_unavailable, never a fallback.

index_version_id.description: Retrieval index version to search. Omitted resolves to the active version; an unknown, unpublished or retired pin returns pin_unavailable, never a fallback.
